title: Correlation Inspector: Waterfall + Faceted Trace Drilldown
creator: Priya Raman
description: Deliver a polished UI pattern for the Console's Trace Drilldown focused on correlation IDs and multi-request waterfalls. This work combines a compact waterfall canvas, faceted filter bar, and an aggregate request inspector so engineers can pivot from high-level dashboards to deterministic request-level debugging. The design should support sharing deep links to a trace, keyboard-first navigation, and smooth transitions between span-level detail and aggregate timelines.
acceptance_criteria: Clickable correlation ID header that expands/collapses all related requests and copies deep link
Waterfall canvas rendering stacked request rows with time-relative alignment and millisecond ruler
Facet filter bar supporting: service, span kind, status code, span tag, and time window
Hover and focus states reveal span-level metadata and quick actions (open logs, open raw trace)
Prototype demonstrates keyboard navigation and aria labels for all interactive elements
Design handoff assets (Figma frames + tokens) and a short dev checklist included
design_notes: Top strip: correlation ID, primary metadata (start time, duration, request count) + share/copy link
Summary banner: aggregated p50/p95/p99 across correlated requests and quick toggles to switch between sum/avg/median
Waterfall canvas: fixed left column for request row header and flexible right timeline canvas. Rows show compact span glyphs by default and expanded details on click
Span visualization: color by span category (network/db/cache/compute). Use high-contrast palette with accessible pairings for colorblind users
Grouping: allow grouping by service or endpoint. Collapsed groups show mini-sparkline of latency distribution
Facet bar: persistent across navigation, supports multi-select chips, search for tag keys, and pinning of frequently used filters
Timeline scrubber and zoom: mouse wheel to zoom, click-drag to select a time window. Zoom state is reflected in the URL for shareability
Mini-aggregate panel: when multiple requests selected show stacked waterfall and percentile overlays to compare
Performance notes: rendering must handle 500 spans in view. Propose virtualized rows and canvas drawing for spans to keep DOM light
Accessibility: focus ring for keyboard focus, roles for canvas landmarks, and screen-reader text for span details
decisions: Show compact span glyphs by default to conserve vertical space; reveal full metadata in an inline drawer
Use grouping-by-service as the default since most users debug cross-service traces; allow switch to endpoint grouping
Encode duration using both width and tooltip; avoid relying on color alone for magnitude
Persist filter state in URL query params to enable bookmarking and sharing
feedback: PM (Jared Li): prefer p95/p99 visible in the header instead of buried in a chart
Eng (Amir Patel): virtualized canvas approach looks good; ask for explicit max-span stress test doc
Security (Olivia Park): deep links must respect RBAC and not leak correlation IDs in logs for restricted projects
Design review (Evelyn Soto): visual density OK but request clearer affordance for toggling between single-trace and aggregated comparison
